limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、cordis.patch.yml、src/dsh-adapter/index.ts、package.json、src/index.ts、bin/dsh-tui.js；profile 挂根适配器，等待宿主 loader 后附接入口屏幕或创建子运行时。首次启动器可安装专用 profile。
limitations: 核查固定 DSH 接线及 launcher，未验其他后端、账号、真实终端或兼容矩阵。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 面向经常在终端运行 DSH 的用户，用同一屏处理会话和工具活动。
profile 挂根适配器，等待宿主 loader 后附接入口屏幕或创建子运行时。首次启动器可安装专用 profile。
核查固定 DSH 接线及 launcher，未验其他后端、账号、真实终端或兼容矩阵。
根包既提供 CLI 又提供 DSH bundle。正式条目类型为客户端，实际发行包未核。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | 环境与模型费用未知 | 核版本和凭据 | 会写专用 profile |
| 持续 | 模型与终端资源未知 | 检查渲染和状态 | 无耗时对照 |
| 失败及退出 | 重跑成本未知 | 核错会话与兼容 | 原界面作为退路 |
[Q03](#research-q03) 在隔离 DSH home 先试已知新会话，再检查恢复与退出。避免把首次自动初始化用于现有重要配置。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 终端接线 | 实际 DSH 适配与服务等待 | 不同终端渲染表现 |
| 恢复 | 启动配置与适配路径 | 续会话身份正确率 |
[Q02](#research-q02) 的等待与接入句柄避免 loader 与运行时彼此等待，并抑制已销毁作用域继续挂屏。
[Q01](#research-q01) 将 DSH 工作反馈放进同一终端。[Q02](#research-q02) 明确区分已有屏幕复用和独立挂载。
[Q03](#research-q03) 首次启动会写专用 profile，实际兼容和旧会话恢复需要先用固定宿主核对。
[Q04](#research-q04) 对照终端会话中断后的恢复，出现错会话或准备时间抵消节省时保持原用法。

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 匹配 DSH、Node 及 pnpm | 首次 DSH profile 必需 | 加载专用适配器 | 核版本与安装结果 |
| 合适终端与账号 | 交互按需 | 渲染与模型调用 | 保留原 CLI/Web |

technical.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的终端交互沿用既有机制，界面映射是小幅增量。[Q02](#research-q02) 将同屏复用与宿主运行时解耦，改变重复装载行为，机制取实质档。一次性句柄有条件适用别的终端接线。入口统一略减操作，首次安装仍需工具，简化小幅。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的终端内状态与交互减少换到 Web 的步骤，流程取实质档。最终会话产物沿用 DSH，新增终端可读状态，小幅交付。经常在纯终端工作的人获得交互入口，可及性实质。未测用时，经济小幅。

recommendation.reason: 常从终端运行 DSH 的用户可以用隔离配置试一次新会话和恢复。它把原本分开查看的工具活动和交互反馈放进同一个终端屏幕。如果启动失败或恢复到了错误的会话，就保留原配置并回到已可用的 DSH 界面。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的 README.md 45–55 行和补丁接线指出日常终端查看、审批和恢复的实际摩擦，强于仅有界面用途。频率缺直接证据，未达充分。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 的适配器 485–515 行支持实质宿主接线，超过简单启动壳。多端行为和效率未知，取部分。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 和 [Q03](#research-q03) 的 Cordis、入口和实际 launcher 覆盖主要流程和失败条件，超过文档宣称；无宿主实测，止于源码。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03) 的 bin/dsh-tui.js 1380–1408 行给出可隔离的安装路径，原配置可作为退路。仍需 pnpm、宿主版本和账号准备，取部分。

data.reports:
# dsh-TUI > 为 DSH 提供交互式终端客户端，显示会话、工具状态、流式输出和上下文。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI) - **版本号**：0.19.0（[固定提交 de73c6f3e5fa8c5b98b7fc87907395f5832c8aa3](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/tree/de73c6f3e5fa8c5b98b7fc87907395f5832c8aa3)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-10（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 源码确认实际 profile 和 Cordis 运行时，真实安装、账号和终端行为未验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：面向经常在终端运行 DSH 的用户，用同一屏处理会话和工具活动。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 将 DSH 工作反馈放进同一终端。[Q02](#research-q02) 明确区分已有屏幕复用和独立挂载。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 首次启动会写专用 profile，实际兼容和旧会话恢复需要先用固定宿主核对。 - **建议**：[Q04](#research-q04) 对照终端会话中断后的恢复，出现错会话或准备时间抵消节省时保持原用法。 采用建议：[Q03](#research-q03) 在隔离 DSH home 先试已知新会话，再检查恢复与退出。避免把首次自动初始化用于现有重要配置。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 将 DSH 工作反馈放进同一终端。[Q02](#research-q02) 明确区分已有屏幕复用和独立挂载。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 首次启动会写专用 profile，实际兼容和旧会话恢复需要先用固定宿主核对。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q04](#research-q04) 对照终端会话中断后的恢复，出现错会话或准备时间抵消节省时保持原用法。 按 [Q04](#research-q04) 用已知会话核恢复、退出及重复装载。 ## 场景与替代办法 面向经常在终端运行 DSH 的用户，用同一屏处理会话和工具活动。 以可用的 DSH 原 CLI 和 Web 界面为比较基线，重点检查同样的审批与会话恢复任务。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 匹配 DSH、Node 及 pnpm | 首次 DSH profile 必需 | 加载专用适配器 | 核版本与安装结果 | | 合适终端与账号 | 交互按需 | 渲染与模型调用 | 保留原 CLI/Web | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 用户选隔离配置 | 确认安装写入范围 | | 核对 | 用户启动新会话，再恢复已知会话 | 工作区和会话对应 | | 退出 | 用户回到原界面 | 保留失败日志 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 环境与模型费用未知 | 核版本和凭据 | 会写专用 profile | | 持续 | 模型与终端资源未知 | 检查渲染和状态 | 无耗时对照 | | 失败及退出 | 重跑成本未知 | 核错会话与兼容 | 原界面作为退路 | #### 效果 | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 终端接线 | 实际 DSH 适配与服务等待 | 不同终端渲染表现 | | 恢复 | 启动配置与适配路径 | 续会话身份正确率 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：在终端操作 DSH 时，TUI 能怎样承接会话，怎样控制首次安装、恢复和重复装载？ ### Q01 · 终端界面为哪些 DSH 任务减少操作？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 面向日常从终端启动 DSH 并需要看到工具、审批和上下文的人。作者描述终端流式文本、工具卡、会话搜索与通知。代码确认该客户端确实挂接 DSH Agent 与工作区并承接会话，界面工作位在终端。相对基本 CLI，它把查看工具状态和交互控件留在同一屏。已有 Web 且需要图形界面的人可能更习惯原工作流。合格任务包括回到正确工作区和会话，辨认工具阶段，并正常退出。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:20-25](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/blob/de73c6f3e5fa8c5b98b7fc87907395f5832c8aa3/README.md#L20-L25) 作者定义产品与后端归属。 ```text > An interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness. It ships a pixel-whale > header, live work status, streaming thinking, double-Esc time rewind, a > context progress bar, and a TPS gauge. Zero core changes: it consumes only > DSH's public exports, and is moving from a mounted plugin to an app with its > own entry and composition root, where DSH loads in process as the first-party > backend. Install to enable; uninstall leaves no patches behind. ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:45-55](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/blob/de73c6f3e5fa8c5b98b7fc87907395f5832c8aa3/README.md#L45-L55) 作者描述终端界面与交互。
查看原文（11行） `````text - **Launchpad and first-run guide** — every ordinary launch lands on a landing page with a **real input box** (big text + whale + quick actions, dropping whole blocks on short/narrow terminals; whale-girl images use a compact native-canvas footprint instead of leaving a large gap before the title; on by default — /settings `launchpad` off boots straight into chat); command completion matches chat: `Tab` fills the input, `Enter` runs the command and clears it. The first run walks a four-step wizard (accounts & models / language+theme / model+workspace / shortcuts), re-runnable with `/setup`; its first step signs in to a subscription and catches the models it brings in (none → no question, one → that one, several → you choose), or adds an API key through the `/provider` wizard, which asks which of the enabled models to switch to or keeps the current one. - **Terminal-native UI** — streaming Markdown, tool cards, `/` and `@` completion, `#L12-14` ranges, history search, zh/en UI. - **Notifications** — one switch covers four system notifications: task completion, a tool approval waiting for your decision, a question waiting for your answer, and a plan review waiting for your decision. Task completion: DSH, Claude and Codex notify after successful live work settles, with no queued follow-up or active goal. The title is “dsh-TUI · Task complete”; the body shows the latest settled reply as a single-line plain-text preview (Markdown formatting removed, up to 200 characters). OSC 777/9 apply an additional 2048-byte sequence budget, including title and protocol bytes, preserving whole graphemes. No reply shows only the title; BEL only rings. `/settings` → Conversation: `taskNotifications` = `unfocused` (default), `always`, or `off`; `notificationMethod` = `auto` (default), `osc9`, `bel`, or `windows`. Auto uses separate title/body fields on Ghostty/WezTerm (OSC 777) and Kitty (OSC 99); iTerm2/Warp and explicit `osc9` use a title prefix; other terminals ring the bell; delivery follows your terminal's notification/bell settings. On local Windows, `auto` resolves to `windows`, the system's native notifications: a task-completion toast. The first toast registers that user's AppUserModelID under HKCU, the toast appears about 3 seconds after the task ends (the PowerShell cold start that buys the no-extra-install route), and for DSH sessions an enabled, active external DSH notification plugin in the running profile makes dsh-TUI yield to it (no toast, no bell); an installed but disabled plugin does not suppress notifications; if that AppUserModelID cannot be written, the notification falls back to the bell instead of going silent. `jumpBack` (Windows, off by default) turns these toasts into a way back to the pane that raised them; it needs the native toast path (`notificationMethod` = `windows`, which `auto` picks on local Windows). With `/settings` → Conversation → `jumpBack` on, the pane title ends with `[dsh-tui:<16 hex>]`, one marker for the life of the process; switching it off removes the suffix at once. While it is on, this process refreshes a marker file at `~/.dsh-tui/notify/jumpback/.json` (`schemaVersion: 1`, `marker`, `pid`, `startedAt`) when the setting is turned on and before each notification it sends, and the first toast that can promise a jump registers the per-user protocol handler (`URL Protocol` plus `shell\open\command`) under `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-tui`; a normal exit removes the file, and removes the key once no other live instance still needs it. Only a pre-send probe that finds exactly one target pane (or tab title) puts an activation URI on the toast; clicking it re-runs five checks — same pane, keyboard focus, marker still in the title, foreground window, not minimized — and refuses rather than jumping anywhere else when any of them fails. A click whose target has gone away changes nothing. Layouts that cannot be verified — a pane in an unselected tab that is not that tab's focused pane, profiles using `suppressApplicationTitle`, and terminals other than Windows Terminal (tested on Windows Terminal 1.24) — get a plain toast whose click changes nothing. The probe adds about half a second before each toast; the first one after enabling can also wait for the helper to compile (a few seconds, once), and a machine whose in-box compiler keeps failing retries it at most every five minutes. External notification senders can read the same marker file and point their own toast at `dsh-tui:activate?m=`; the URI and file format are a read-only contract, and this release ships no plugin-side implementation. SSH sessions keep the attached terminal's notification protocol in `auto` mode; explicit `windows` still selects the host's native transport. tmux requires `set -g allow-passthrough on` for OSC notifications and `set -g focus-events on` for focus reporting. Terminals without focus reporting need `always`. Replay, cancellation and failures do not notify. Works in inline and fullscreen modes. A tool approval adds its own notification: the title is “dsh-TUI · Approval needed”; the body carries the session name, the tool name and the asker's reason. The reason is host-provided text (the model's own justification can appear verbatim), so it is normalized to one plain line and length-capped, but the body makes no redaction promise; the tool call's arguments are never read for it. A native toast still being prepared is dropped if the switch turns off, the session is no longer the attached one, or the approval, question or plan review is no longer waiting. Every approval notifies, and only the current session’s does; background sessions and subagents stay quiet. The switch covers all four, so `off` silences approvals, questions and plan reviews along with completions. An enabled, active external DSH notification plugin still makes dsh-TUI yield for completions, approvals and questions; a plan review never yields, and outside local Windows (or in SSH) the existing terminal notification protocol or bell is used. An ordinary question adds its own notification: the title is “dsh-TUI · Waiting for your answer” and the body carries the first question's header and question; options and detail stay in the panel. Local wizard and sign-in questionnaires announce the same way; a subagent's question stays in the panel in this release; the 0.2.2 approval-intent asks are announced the same way as an ordinary question. A plan review is announced as “dsh-TUI · Plan review” and carries the question header and question, never the plan itself, and it is the one notice that does not yield: an external notifier maps approvals and ordinary questions to its own notification but not a plan review, so yielding would leave only its generic idle notice, which never says a plan review is waiting. - **Native cursor** — focused text inputs inherit your terminal's cursor shape, color, blinking, and enabled animation or trail effects in both inline and fullscreen modes. The `/model` picker shows the same cursor during movement between provider tabs, model rows, and effort levels, then hides it after **0.5 seconds at rest**; clipped regions fall back to the model row. The session manager also moves this cursor between the workspace rail, session rows, and search box; typing claims the search caret, and navigation returns it to the focused row. Configure animation and trail effects in your terminal. - **Images** — Kitty/Sixel thumbnails, centered preview with zoom and pan, paste-time fitting, text fallback. Kitty images scale to the reserved cells' physical pixels, including on HiDPI terminals. - **Mermaid diagrams** — ````mermaid ```` fences drawn as Unicode diagrams. - **LaTeX math** — `$…$` and `$$…$$` formulas as Unicode text, fractions and limits stacked in display blocks; `mathRendering: image` typesets block and one-row inline formulas as terminal images on graphics terminals. - **Timeline rail** — every turn clickable; timeline / scrollbar / hidden gutter. - **Side panel** — `Ctrl+B` splits the chat with a panel column once the terminal is wide enough; drag the divider to resize it. All eight built-in panels are enabled by default, and so are plugin panels registered later (`sidePanel.panels: '*'`; untick a row in `/settings` to switch to an explicit list). The header shows each inactive panel's symbol; hover to see its name. Narrow terminals and inline mode keep full-screen panels. In the `todo` panel a long goal wraps to the panel width with its phase on a separate row; when the content exceeds the viewport, focus the panel and scroll with `↑`/`↓` or the wheel (every todo is reachable too) (the compact goal row above the chat input stays a single truncated line with a hover tooltip). - **Live state** — activity animation, context bar, TPS, cache hit rate, effort, tokens, session cost estimate (main + subagents), Git and session metadata. Title, trajectory-strip and session-state animations update independently of the transcript and pause when idle or unfocused. Context-bar fill follows backend occupancy; colors estimate content composition. Compaction clears obsolete estimates, and missing composition displays a single used block with a measured used count in both hover details. `````

查看原文（10行） ```text # The interactive front door. The plugin creates/resumes its agent at # runtime, seeds the startup status line, and disposes the whole app tree # (exiting the process) when the TUI unmounts. `dsh-tui --resume` # feeds the session id through DSH_TUI_RESUME_SESSION (see # src/sessionHistory.ts for the launcher contract). - id: dsh-tui name: '@deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui' # The entry-level dependency augments the plugin's `agents` inject and # prevents startup Session creation from racing WorkspaceRegistry init. inject: [workspaceRegistry, agents, tuiWorkspaces, tuiScenes, tuiPanels, tuiDialogs, tuiStatus, tuiShortcuts, tuiRenderers, tuiThemes] ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[src/dsh-adapter/index.ts:485-512](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/blob/de73c6f3e5fa8c5b98b7fc87907395f5832c8aa3/src/dsh-adapter/index.ts#L485-L512) 宿主行按当前屏幕实例选择实际挂载路径。
查看原文（28行） ```text export async function apply(ctx: Context, config: RuntimeConfig): Promise { // The entry already mounted the screen in this process (./entry-slot.ts): // the row only runs the DSH side and hands the session to that screen. const entrySlot = peekEntrySlot() if (entrySlot !== undefined) { entrySlot.rowSeen = true attachToEntry(ctx, config) return } // Upstream drift is NO LONGER spammed to stderr here: per-package // console.warn lines interleave with the TUI frame redraw and arrive // garbled (typewriter animation repaints over them). The merged, // natural-language notice now renders in the logo header under the // startup tip (LogoV2 ← upstreamDriftSummary); CI keeps the hard gate // via scripts/verify-upstream-contract.ts. const { apply: tuiApply, handleStartupError } = await import('./plugin.js') let disposed = false ctx.effect(() => () => { disposed = true }) // Registry diagnostics can await the whole Loader.
